news.headline: Lilly Left Nektar Drug 'Damaged Goods,' Jury Told At Trial End
news.summary: In closing arguments in the N.D. Cal. breach-of-contract trial, Nektar's counsel told the jury Eli Lilly turned rezpegaldesleukin into 'damaged goods' by breaching the 2018 co-development deal and delaying the drug in favor of a competing atopic-dermatitis asset (Dermira's lebrikizumab) Lilly later acquired. The case, seeking roughly $1 billion in damages, went to the jury after closing arguments concluded Friday, September 18, 2026.

news.headline: Lilly Owes Nektar $1B If It Breached Rezpeg Deal, Jury Told
news.summary: Nektar's damages expert testified to the California federal jury that Eli Lilly could owe Nektar nearly $1 billion in the rezpegaldesleukin breach-of-contract trial if jurors find Lilly breached the license and co-development agreement for the drug.

news.headline: Nektar CEO Opens Door To Finance Questions In Eli Lilly Trial
news.summary: Nektar failed to keep evidence of its financial condition out of the trial after CEO testimony on cross-examination prompted the judge to allow Lilly to introduce it for impeachment purposes, a tactical setback for Nektar as the case proceeded before the N.D. Cal. jury.

news.headline: Eli Lilly 'Sabotaged' Rezpeg's Development, Nektar Tells Jury as Trial Opens; Company Enters Quiet Period Ahead of REZOLVE-AA Data
news.summary: Opening statements began September 8, 2026 in Nektar v. Eli Lilly, with Nektar alleging Lilly breached the rezpeg co-development deal and 'sabotaged' the drug in favor of its own competing pipeline asset. The same day, Nektar disclosed in an 8-K that it is entering a quiet period until it publicly announces data from the 24-week off-treatment follow-up period of the Phase 2b REZOLVE-AA alopecia areata study.

news.headline: Nektar CEO Slams Eli Lilly's 'Egregious Error,' Laments Lost Time for Rezpeg on Q2 Earnings Call
news.summary: On Nektar's Q2 2026 earnings call, CEO Howard Robin criticized Lilly's handling of early rezpeg trial data as an 'egregious error' that set back development timelines. Separately, JPMorgan reinstated coverage of NKTR with a Neutral rating on August 20, 2026, while Piper Sandler maintained a Buy/Overweight rating with a $192 price target.

news.headline: Nektar Therapeutics Announces Second Quarter 2026 Financial Results
news.summary: Nektar reported Q2 2026 revenue of $10.1 million and a net loss of $40.6 million ($1.23/share); cash and investments stood at $1,023.4 million as of June 30, 2026 (up from $245.8 million at year-end 2025), supported by a public offering. The company confirmed it initiated the first two Phase 3 ZENITH AD trials (of three planned, ~1,530 patients total) in atopic dermatitis in July 2026, plans a single registrational Phase 3 alopecia areata trial in early 2027, and guided to a cash runway into Q3 2028, past initial Phase 3 ZENITH AD topline data expected mid-2028.

catalysts.label: Nektar v. Eli Lilly jury verdict
catalysts.detail: Closing arguments concluded September 18, 2026 in the N.D. Cal. breach-of-contract trial over the terminated rezpegaldesleukin co-development deal, and the case is now with the jury. Nektar's damages expert testified Lilly could owe close to $1 billion if the jury finds breach; a verdict could land within days to weeks and represents a binary, market-moving legal catalyst independent of clinical data.

catalysts.label: REZOLVE-AA 24-week off-treatment durability data (alopecia areata)
catalysts.detail: Nektar entered a quiet period on September 8, 2026 that runs until it publicly announces 24-week off-treatment follow-up data from the Phase 2b REZOLVE-AA study (92 patients, severe-to-very-severe alopecia areata). This readout tests whether hair-regrowth benefits from rezpegaldesleukin persist after dosing stops, a key durability question given alopecia's tendency to relapse; exact date not yet disclosed but company framing signals proximity.

catalysts.label: Start of registrational Phase 3 alopecia areata trial
catalysts.detail: Nektar guided on its Q2 2026 earnings call that it plans to initiate a single registrational Phase 3 study of rezpegaldesleukin in alopecia areata in early 2027, contingent on the REZOLVE-AA durability data supporting advancement.

catalysts.label: Q3 2026 earnings report
catalysts.detail: Based on Nektar's recent quarterly cadence (Q2 2026 results were released August 13, 2026), Q3 2026 financial results and a pipeline/legal update are expected in mid-November 2026. This would be the first quarterly update following the Lilly trial verdict and any REZOLVE-AA data.

catalysts.label: ZENITH AD Phase 3 topline data (atopic dermatitis)
catalysts.detail: Initial topline data from the Phase 3 ZENITH AD-1 and ZENITH AD-2 trials (initiated July 2026, ~510 patients each, 1,530 total across the three-trial program) are expected mid-2028, with a targeted BLA submission in 2029. This is the pivotal long-term catalyst underpinning Nektar's largest indication.

pulse: NKTR shares have rallied sharply in 2026 (from roughly $42 at year-start to the $70-75 range by mid-September) on strong Phase 2b rezpegaldesleukin data, a fortified balance sheet (~$1.0B cash, runway into Q3 2028), and Phase 3 ZENITH AD trial initiation, even as the stock stays volatile around binary events. The dominant near-term catalyst is the Nektar v. Eli Lilly breach-of-contract trial, which went to the jury after closing arguments on September 18, 2026 with roughly $1 billion in damages at stake, closely followed by the pending Phase 2b REZOLVE-AA 24-week off-treatment alopecia areata data (company in quiet period since September 8, expected in the coming months). The narrative is a comeback story pairing legal-verdict optionality against Lilly with a multi-year pivot toward pivotal Phase 3 readouts in atopic dermatitis (mid-2028) and alopecia areata.
